ModMetaData.name: Hog Shuttle
ModMetaData.author: MagosZ
ModMetaData.description:
A small, boxy spacer shuttle built on Vehicle Framework and VTOL Vehicle.
THE SHUTTLE - Footprint 4×7 (the body is a box once its wings are out). Lands on three skids. - Crew: 1 pilot (required, Intellectual 6 or more) and 1 co-pilot (optional). Passengers: 8. Cargo: about 1,000 kg. - Fuel: chemfuel. - Armament: none built in; a rear door gun and a roof autocannon can be fitted (see UPGRADES).
FLIGHT - Hovers on the local map (VTOL): take off, fly, land, auto-land on a saved spot, board nearby colonists. - Flies across the world map like other Vehicle Framework aircraft. - With Odyssey: flies to space (gravships, orbital sites, asteroids) and back. Each climb into space or drop back down costs 50 chemfuel, and flying between places in space burns fuel 10 times faster than in the air. A full tank (1200) covers about 720 tiles in the air. - Sealed cabin: everything aboard, crew, passengers and cargo, stays at 21°C wherever the shuttle is, and pawns aboard take no vacuum (with Odyssey). Passengers still get hungry, heal and so on as in any Vehicle Framework vehicle, and food in the hold ages as in a 21°C room.
UPGRADES - Auxiliary flight computer: 1 advanced component, 200 work. Lets anyone who can fly a vehicle pilot the shuttle, whatever their Intellectual skill. - Plasteel armour: 150 plasteel, 4 components, 6000 work. About 20% more armour on every part, cockpit included, but 200 kg less cargo (800 kg). - Cargo outfit: no cost, 500 work. 2 passenger seats instead of 8, and 1000 kg more cargo (2000 kg; 1800 kg with the plasteel armour). - Rear door gun, one of three: medium machine gun (150 steel, 5 components), heavy machine gun (205 steel, 6 components) or minigun (135 steel, 11 components); 5000 work. Adds a door gunner seat; fires 60 degrees either side of straight back. The guns are the door guns of VVE - Secondary Weapons (required), with its art, sounds and Combat Extended support. - Twin-linked autocannon: 200 steel, 30 plasteel, 6 components, 6000 work, 50 kg less cargo. A vanilla autocannon turret's gun with two barrels bound together on the roof: range 33, 6-round bursts (with Combat Extended: range 78, 20-round bursts, 20x102mm shells). Fixed forward; the pilot fires it and aims by turning the shuttle. A pilot incapable of violence can fly but can't fire it, and you get a message when one takes the seat. - Chemical toilet (with Dubs Bad Hygiene): 10 steel, 10 neutroamine, as much work as a wooden wall. Keeps the bladder of everyone aboard satisfied.
COMBAT EXTENDED - Optional. With CE, the shuttle's armour uses CE-scale ratings (based on the Hind Gunship's), and the plasteel armour upgrade adds 20% of those. Without CE, vanilla ratings apply.
RESEARCH - "Hog shuttle" in the Vehicles research tab (Vanilla Vehicles Expanded). Needs aerial vehicles and, with Odyssey, shuttle. - Spacer tech, hi-tech research bench and multi-analyzer.
